INSERT INTO search_index (id, org_id, entity_kind, entity_id, parent_id, title, body)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
           ON CONFLICT (org_id, entity_kind, entity_id) DO UPDATE SET
             parent_id = EXCLUDED.parent_id,
             title = EXCLUDED.title,
             body = EXCLUDED.body,
             indexed_at = now()
